svg.title: FIG-17 Target H743 Flash RAM boundary Selected V / Cache off; complete software and ELF exits open
svg.desc: One authored TOML + reviewed facts Immutable IR; selected-only bundle and CMake; External maintenance caller Own scheduling, bus-master joins and recovery policy; Cold typed factory Return an existing immutable Flash face; Flash face Shared read-only ops + private context; Explicit Platform lifecycle Prepare selected bytes; retain failed cleanup; One private H743 Flash controller owner: target design; Flash provider Validate operation, region, aliases and call context; Cold RAM preparation Validate LOAD / RUN; copy and prove readiness; CPU-only RAM bridge Preserve CPU state; install private MSP; Entire busy transaction in AXI RAM Publish / restore VTOR; retain input and diagnostics; Private MPU guard in RAM Code XN + Strongly-ordered; AP001; CTRL7; supplies proved code and private RAM; direct call after final admission; calls with private MSP; transaction owns VTOR; installs before trigger; restores after drain; Actual Flash controller / both banks Program stores or erase START; observe drain and LOCK; Existing System TIM2 domain and epoch Prove wrap service; never invent lost time; emits selected preparation / cleanup; emits static face and shared ops reference; looks up typed Flash identity; returns existing reference; no preparation; explicit start / stop call; calls preparation before use; direct synchronous I/O call; ops(context, ...) call; precondition: quiesce and join other masters; validated writes / actual status observations; same-domain deadline and epoch observations
